messages.subject: Group specific variance term
parts:
I would like to fit a model of the following form:

y_ij ~ poisson(lambda_ij)
lambda_ij = mu_j*x_ij + epsilon_ij
epsilon_ij ~ N(0, sigma_j)

Said another way I want epsilon_i ~ N(0, diag(sigma)). 

Is it possible to fit this model in R-INLA? Specifically is it possible to have the group specific variance (sigma_j) rather than just having all epsilon_ij having the same variance?

Thank you!
Justin

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Group specific variance term
parts:
If u have few groups , yes
If you know their relative scaling, you can use that
